grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Saturday for Li Ming
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须从原文中直接抄写，不要改变单词形式。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
passage: Li Ming is a student. He was at the library on Saturday morning. He studied English there for two hours. He was with his friend, Wang Fang. They were quiet. At noon, they were hungry. They went to a small restaurant. Li Ming ate noodles. Wang Fang ate rice. The food was good. In the afternoon, Li Ming was at home. He was tired. He watched TV. He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow. He is going to take a bus. He is happy because he likes his grandmother. Wang Fang is going to stay home tomorrow. She is going to do her homework. She is not going to watch TV.

questions.evidence: He was with his friend, Wang Fang.

questions.evidence: He is going to take a bus.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to 表计划
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 和 were 来说过去的事情。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。我们用 be going to 来说将来的计划，be 动词要跟主语一致：I am going to, he/she/it is going to, you/we/they are going to。because 用来连接原因。
grammar.example: He was at the library on Saturday morning. He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ______ at home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，过去时用 was。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ______ happy last night.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是复数，过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I ______ going to buy a book tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用 am going to 表示计划。
questions.evidence: I am going to buy a book tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：We are going to stay home ______ it is raining.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，这里“下雨”是待在家里的原因。
questions.evidence: We are going to stay home because it is raining.
